workload.decode: segmented bucketed trace (stage 10, max_seq_len >= 65,536); MoE active-count buckets off at 1 slot; prefill pool-key views on

layer_stack_lower_bound_note: stage-5 sum of the 45 layers' traced replays at stage-5 reference precision (GLM53_PRECISION=none) on the shipped DEFAULT_MC (doc/optimized_multichip_decoder/README.md); not measured at combo_a_kv. The earlier 52.3 ms was measured with ag_persistent on
device_time_note: no device-time estimate at combo_a_kv and 280,576 tokens. The stage-7-precision estimate (stage-5 per-kind device time 865 / 1070 / 1332 us x (3, 31, 11) = 50.4 ms + LM head 0.47 + sampler 0.38 = 51.3 ms) applies to the 16,384-token row only (model trace 50.71 ms). At 280,576 the sparse indexer scores the whole allocated pool (+5.1 ms, see named_limitations)
roofline_note: DRAM roofline per decoder layer from stage 5 (doc/optimized_multichip_decoder): kda_dense 175, kda_moe 169, dsa_moe 179 us per layer per die (weight + cache bytes / DRAM bandwidth) x (3, 31, 11) layers + LM head 168 MB / 512 GB/s ~ 0.33 ms = 8.1 ms per token (stage-7 precision weight bytes; combo_a_kv's bfp4 projections lower it slightly)
named_limitations: context-size cost: resolved by stage 10 (86403d19830, segmented bucketed decode and bucketed sparse prefill for max_seq_len >= 65,536). Before it the sparse DSA indexer scored every allocated pool slot: 16,384 vs 280,576 -> token-out 51.10 vs 56.24 ms, 8K TTFT 4,408 vs 6,444 ms; stage 10 measured 55.07 -> 50.10 ms and 6.46 -> 5.83 s at 280,576
decoder layers are ~97 % of the step; terminal path (LM head 471 us, sampler 0.39 ms, glue ~0.25 ms) ~1.1 ms

LM head 471 us (measured 2026-10-17: interleaved bfp8, stage-7 precision, 168 MB per die); HEAD's default runs a bfp4 LM head with its own decode program (decode_specs.lm_head), not profiled here; DRAM-sharded column splits were slower (10 x 66 us)
128-row prefill chunk is device-bound (~5 ms per layer): prefill traces save 10 ms only

persistent decode all-gather (ag_persistent) is off in the shipped DEFAULT_MC: not adopted, available via MCOpts. Re-tested on the fixed code (b3270061cca, combo_a_kv + kda_in): quality identical (TF on 3 references, reduced 8-slot repeats), -0.44 ms per token (49.96 vs 50.40 ms at 16,384, runs/s7r2/agp{0,1}.json), +71,680 B per bank (~0.55 MiB per die). Kept off because persistent outputs skip the all-gather start barrier and one buffer per site is reused by all 45 layers: one run per setting cannot exclude a race; per-layer-parity ping-pong buffers not tried. Stage 12 (d86fe3c874d): adopted (ping-pong buffers per layer parity, DEFAULT_MC ag_persistent=True), see doc/decode_perf_stage12/README.md
inactive-row MoE skip rebuilds its sentinel in each of 42 MoE layers: +1.1 % at 8 active (112.24 vs 110.97 ms skip off). Stage 12 (d86fe3c874d): built once per step (GLM53_SENT_ONCE=1, default)
device time of the full step not profiled (full-stack Tracy forbidden); 1-layer Tracy windows (2026-10-17) are stale
